scripts.build: npm run prisma:generate -w packages/api && npm run build -w packages/infrastructure && npm run build -w packages/api && npm run build -w packages/web
scripts.dev: npm run build -w packages/api && concurrently -n api,web,serve -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev -w packages/api" "npm run dev -w packages/web" "node --watch packages/api/dist/src/api/app.js"
scripts.lint: eslint eslint.config.mjs packages/api packages/infrastructure packages/web scripts && prettier --check package.json tsconfig.base.json .prettierrc README.md CHANGELOG.md DECISIONS.md DEPLOY.md render.yaml docs packages/api packages/infrastructure packages/web scripts
scripts.test: npm run test -w packages/api && npm run test -w packages/infrastructure && npm run test -w packages/web
